assets.title: Open-Frame Harbor Marker Buoy
assets.description: One original low-poly static harbor marker-buoy exterior, counted as one prop. A broad low faceted closed float body has a sloping upper shoulder and short neck over a narrower closed ballast-shaped lower body with a finite flat dry-display sole. Four separated square posts form an open short frame with four genuine side windows and an empty middle. A solid square header connects the posts to one thick upright chamfered geometric top plaque. A single thick lower lug has a genuine through-eye, a complete finite top-root contact and positive clearance above the floor. Nine named editable closed meshes and four opaque constant PBR colours: muted ochre float, dark graphite lower body, deep violet frame and pale mint top plaque. No texture, words, numbers, lights, reflective surfaces, water, rope, chain, anchor, boat, pier, animation or alternate size/colour set. Metres, native Z up, front -Y and origin at the circular body axis on ground Z=0. The original broad-body/open-frame/top-plaque/eye combination is not a scaled fishing float, filled lifebuoy, modified barrel or miniature lighthouse. One fixed dry-display visual pose only. Finite contacts, closed surfaces and empty-volume tests establish geometry only. No buoyancy, stability, draft, water dynamics, anchoring or mooring loads, reflection, illumination, navigation meaning, maritime standard, safety certification, manufacture, strength, installation, moving mechanism or compatibility with any previous pier, boat or rope asset is claimed. The custom palette and geometric top plaque have no asserted navigational significance.
